Generate
Bug's duration is extended for 1 turn. Every time an enemy is inflicted with Weakness Break, Silver Wolf has a 100% base chance of implanting a random Bug in the enemy.

Inject
At the start of the battle, immediately regenerates 20 Energy. Silver Wolf regenerates 5 Energy at the start of her turn.

Side Note
For every 10% Effect Hit Rate that Silver Wolf has, additionally increases her ATK by 10% to a max of 50%.
